description: The authors publish an archived code resource for generating the radiation-field dataset in a simplified nuclear-facility scenario. The parent collection states that a typical facility space was simplified and modelled, different source-term distributions were used, and the Monte Carlo program MCShield simulated three-dimensional radiation parameters. Figshare lists one RAR archive descriptor of 2,461,444,742 bytes under CC0, with public free access. This record describes the deposited generation code, not a separately verified general MCShield installation or the associated generated data. Coverage is a generic simplified facility scenario, with no named operating site or country. The native code description repeats its title and does not state a language, interface, dependencies, parameter controls or a version of MCShield. Specific use from the controlled simulation-use vocabulary remains unknown. A limitation is that the archive was not opened or executed, so code contents, radiation accuracy and compatibility are unverified. The related dataset remains a distinct existing data resource.
